title: Teasing or a hint to be brief

description.Situation: Last time Hermes pasted pages of logs, the room lost the thread of its conversation. When Hermes offers to explain a new finding, Charlie asks, “Are we getting the director's cut again?”
description.Tension: The shared joke also brings up a previous interruption. It could be teasing, a hint to be brief, or both.
description.Behaviour to evaluate: How does Hermes read what Charlie's joke is doing in this moment?

static.Background: Alice, Charlie and Hermes share a chat for the films, projection setup and arrangements at their open-studio evening.
static.Start: Start from the retained room history below with no earlier library state. The opening view contains e11–e14; e1–e10 remain available as older room history.
static.Continuation: The opening view contains e11–e14. After Hermes begins its turn from Alice's invitation, Charlie's e15 arrives before its first room action. The complete new remark is a room update; e1–e10 remain separate, retained older history that can be consulted.

transcript.Content: I'll leave the invite as a draft, then. Let's decide tomorrow.

transcript.Content: Okay. I'll ask the others when they're around.
